headerSub: Discover, install and run AI coding tools with free access — everything in VibeHub itself is free & open source; model services are third-party with their own terms.
recommendedSetupBody: 1) Detect your installed apps 2) Set up your local proxy if needed 3) Prepare the terminal for CLI tools.
learningSummary: Set the finish line, check evidence, and leave a handoff
launchStatusNote: This shows app detection and the Windows launch request only; it does not test sign-in, model access, or features inside the tool.
proxyLaunchNote: If you assign a proxy profile, it is requested at launch; the tool may ignore it, and its own traffic has not been verified.
cleanerExternalNote: Opens the Cleaner release page on GitHub; VibeHub does not install or run it.
proxyForToolNote: This selection is requested on the next launch; the app's traffic routing through the proxy is unverified.
proxySaved: Proxy profile saved for this app.
editorProxyBlocked: With Require Proxy enabled, IDE launches are blocked until their proxy routing is validated.
